title: Cross-Layer Characterization and AI-Assisted Diagnosis of C-to-Rust Performance
abstract: arXiv:2611.33490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Migrating C code to Rust can significantly improve software security, but understanding the performance implications of such migrations remains challenging. While Rust is often claimed to match C's performance, runtime safety checks, compiler optimizations, and hardware microarchitecture interact in ways that complicate performance diagnosis. We first conduct a systematic cross-layer characterization of 12 benchmarks comprising C implementations and their Rust counterparts. Our study reveals that runtime safety checks do not necessarily dominate performance overhead, as compiler and microarchitectural optimizations often mitigate their costs. Across 8 of the 12 benchmarks, at least one Rust implementation performs within 10% of its C counterpart or outperforms it. translated_title: C到Rust迁移性能的跨层表征与AI辅助诊断
translated_abstract: 将C代码迁移到Rust可以显著提升软件安全性，但理解此类迁移对性能的影响仍然具有挑战性。尽管Rust常被认为能够媲美C的性能，但运行时安全检查、编译器优化和硬件微体系结构之间以复杂的方式相互作用，使性能诊断变得困难。我们首先对包含12个基准测试的C实现及其对应的Rust实现进行了系统的跨层表征研究。我们的研究表明，运行时安全检查并不一定是性能开销的主导因素，因为编译器和微体系结构层面的优化通常会缓解其成本。在12个基准测试中的8个里，至少有一个Rust实现的性能在其C对应版本的10%以内或超越了它。基于这些发现，我们提出了FerroScope，一个AI辅助的性能调试器，它集成了源码级分析、编译器优化提示和动态插桩等技术（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过对12个C/Rust基准程序的跨层表征揭示了运行时安全检查并非Rust迁移性能开销的主因（编译器与微架构优化常可缓解其成本），并据此提出了集成源码分析、编译器优化提示与动态插桩的AI辅助性能调试器FerroScope。
en_tdlr: This paper shows through cross-layer characterization of 12 C/Rust benchmarks that runtime safety checks do not necessarily dominate migration overhead, and introduces FerroScope, an AI-assisted performance debugger integrating source-level analysis, compiler optimization remarks, and dynamic instrumentation to diagnose C-to-Rust performance issues.
